description:
[Inventory] How each skin in an inventory moved: then vs now. The Performance tab of rust.wiki/inventory/{steamid}: for every skin in the STORED inventory (look it up with
`/inventory/{steamid}` first if it was never checked), its Steam price `then` (that day's average sale, or the
store price for `all`) and `now`, with `change` and `change_pct` for the whole stack (`quantity`), plus totals:
`value_then`, `value_now`, `change`, `change_pct`, `winners`, `losers`. `no_history` counts skins with no price
for that date. Cents. No Steam call - stored price history only; cached 10 minutes. No key needed. Which skins in an inventory gained or lost most over a period. Look the inventory up with get_inventory first if it returns no skins.

range.description: Compare against one day, week, month, 3/6 months, 1/2/5 years ago, or `all` (each skin's original store price, else its first Steam sale).

sort.description: `gain`/`loss` = biggest change in cents for the whole stack; `pct_gain`/`pct_loss` = biggest % change; `value` = most valuable now.

name: get_inventory_performance
title: How each skin in an inventory moved: then vs now
